chapters.text: Make an invoice for a client, then send it to Samad or the boss to sign and approve.
Open Invoices and click New invoice. From a deal, open Payments and click Make invoice next to an installment.
Fill in the client, phone and email, then the items. Totals add up by themselves.
Choose who approves it and click Save and send for approval. They get an alert.
Once it's approved, share it on WhatsApp, copy the link, or email it. The client can sign it online.
